name: UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Scheme
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a Reader/Associate Professor/Professor in the Science and Technology departments of a university. 1. The applicant should have successfully supervised: - 15 Ph.D. dissertations in Basic Sciences, or - 10 Ph.D. dissertations in Engineering and Technology. - At least 5 candidates must have received their degrees in the preceding 10 years. 1. The cumulative impact factor of the published papers by the applicant should be > 50 (according to the Journal citation Reports of Thomson Reuters). 1. The applicant must have handled, as Principal Investigator, at least 3 sponsored research projects funded by national / international agencies, in the last 10 years. 1. The applicant must apply within one year of the date of superannuation in the University. 1. The applicant shall not hold any administrative responsibility during tenure of the fellowship which would be from the date of superannuation. 1. The Department / School / University shall have to provide an undertaking in the application that the applicant would be provided: - with the required laboratory infrastructure and administrative assistance for undertaking the fellowship work and - with permission to take a minimum of Two stipendiary candidates for Ph.D. under the applicant, if selected for the UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Award.
